description: Curated source baskets for comparative NewsLens analysis. Inclusion is for comparison and coverage diversity, not endorsement.

groups.label: Progressive / Independent
groups.selection_reason: High-signal independent and adversarial reporting with clean RSS and scraped article text.

groups.label: Hard-Right / Populist Conservative
groups.selection_reason: High-contrast right-wing media sources that passed readiness checks and provide a meaningfully different framing set.

groups.label: Far-Left / Socialist
groups.selection_reason: Explicitly socialist outlets with clean scraped article bodies and high contrast against mainstream and conservative sources.

groups.label: Indigenous / Native News
groups.selection_reason: Indigenous-focused sources with working feeds and clean article extraction, prioritizing Native-led reporting.

groups.label: Black Press / Black-Focused News
groups.selection_reason: Black-led or Black-focused outlets with clean RSS and article extraction, balancing nonprofit/local reporting with historic Black press.

groups.label: Environmental / Climate
groups.selection_reason: Climate, clean-energy, conservation, and environmental accountability sources that produce clean judge-ready article text.
